text:
sam_sales: Hey team — ArborAI wants to go into a POC next week. They need an on‑prem 'entitlement proxy' that integrates with their IdP (SAML) and our SCIM delta sync, plus OPA policy evaluation for RBAC. Asking for: dedicated pricing, data residency, and a quick security questionnaire answer pack. Can we list blockers?

toni_se: Thanks — couple clarifying q's: 1) Do they want SCIM full sync or just delta/resync endpoints? 2) Will the proxy terminate SAML locally or pass-through to cloud?

sam_sales: Delta only, they said. Proxy must terminate SAML on prem (company policy), but must send signed assertions upstream to Redwood for audit.

maria_pse: Ok. Termination on prem means we need a private connector (Private deploy) + ability to forward signed JWTs/assertions. Need to confirm cert rotation cadence and KMS/HSM requirements.

alex_sre: For certs: we support manual rotation and ACME-based automation in Private. If they need HSM, that's an enterprise add-on. Also OPA hook: we can call a local OPA sidecar or push policies to our evaluate pipeline — which do they prefer?

sam_sales: Customer prefers local OPA sidecar for latency and audit.

toni_se: Action items: - maria to draft infra sketch for onprem connector + OPA sidecar topology. - alex to call out cert/KMS options + scoping constraints. - legal_qa to start SQA answers (they attached PDF). I'll follow up on pricing.

maria_pse: Sketch posted in confluence: https://redwood.internal/confluence/arborai-poc (private link). High level: small VM running connector, reverse proxy for SAML, SCIM delta webhook to our SCIM ingest endpoint, local OPA that returns allow/deny + audit log forwarded to Redwood console.

alex_sre: A few gotchas: SCIM delta implies webhook reliability and retry window. We recommend at least 24h replay retention and idempotent change tokens. Also note SCIM bulk import will be slower over airgapped links.

sam_sales: They're also asking about pricing for Dedicated vs Private onprem perpetual license. Any ballpark for seat-based entitlements + connector fee?

maria_pse: Ballpark: Private deployment platform fee + per-connector monthly (for support/updates) + optional HSM license. I'll post numbers in a separate doc.

legal_qa: Got the SQA PDF. I'll answer standard items today (data flows, encryption at rest/in-transit, SOC/ISO attestation). For anything that mentions 'export of assertions', ping me — we may need to log exact assertion payloads for compliance.

toni_se: Quick config snippet for SCIM delta subscription they can use: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Subscriptons
{
  "callbackUrl": "https://onprem-connector.arborai.local/scim/callback",
  "filters": "Resources eq \"User\"",
  "auth":"mutual_tls"
}
```

sam_sales: Nice. Also customer asked about domain proofing: they want to auto-claim domains during onboarding. Is our domain claim flow compatible with onprem connectors?

alex_sre: Yes, domain proofing uses DNS TXT by default. For onprem we can do a TXT via their registrar or allow them to upload proof artifact to the connector UI. Need to confirm they own DNS for subdomains.

maria_pse: Note: if they require SAML audience restriction changes, we might need a canary because some IdPs will break assertions. Recommend a short canary POC with 50 users.

sam_sales: I'll propose 50-user canary. One more ask: they want sample SAML metadata and a sample SCIM delta event.

toni_se: Dropping samples here: 
SAML metadata: `https://redwood-demo/saml/metadata.xml`
SCIM delta sample payload: 
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "replace",
      "value": {"userName":"jdoe","active":false}
    }
  ]
}
```

deploy-bot: POC environment (arborai-poc-2026) provisioned in sandbox region. URL: https://poc-sandbox.redwood.internal/arborai (credentials in 1Password).

sam_sales: Great — next: maria + alex can we have a one-hour tech presales call with ArborAI on Tue 09:00 PT? I'll send invite.

maria_pse: Yup. I'll bring the infra sketch and connector checklist.

alex_sre: I'll bring cert/KMS options and OPA integration doc.

legal_qa: I'll join for the first 15 for SQA highlights.

sam_sales: Thanks all. I'll attach SQA PDF + their network diagram to the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
